item: Bulletin, card audit and hardware probes: log through log_failure and keep only the failure's class in records
key_paths: src/bulletin src/api/bulletin.py src/briefing/card_audit.py src/llm/backend.py tests/test_bulletin_sink_sites.py tests/test_bulletin_sink_sites_rest.py tests/test_runs_log_sinks.py
summary: Every log call in src/bulletin, src/api/bulletin.py and src/briefing/card_audit.py (34 asked for exc_info) goes through secret_scrub.log_failure, and a record that a file, the backup or the diagnostics bundle keeps names the failure's class and none of its words (the words are in the scrubbed log line): the edition and the annexes, the card audit rows, the disclosures, the translator's refused-frame reason, and the three hardware-probe handlers in src/llm/backend.py whose words were cut to 120 characters before any scrub and reached every edition through the gate. A route's refusal, the built-but-not-saved answer and the evidence plan's folder check keep the words through exception_text and chain no cause. Handlers that logged nothing now log first, so class-only moves the words and does not delete them. The source guard reads the whole bulletin directory, excuses words by (function, line) with a count, and uses one helper for the sweep and its snippets. Fourteen entries leave the exc_info allowlist. Tests: 48 cases that drive each site with a held passphrase, a key statement and the engine's own words, nine old tests now assert the class, and the fold mutants (22 of 22) and the first read's (every site) all fail a test.
